title: How do I get Antigravity agent to make a simple model in blender?
author: More-Drink2211
selftext:
A few days back, after I saw some posts on this sub about how people were using AI agents to make their models effortlessly, I decided to try it out, by downloading Google Antigravity. I sorta don't have much money on hand, so I decided to use the Free Tier with quota.

I put it to the task of making a simple model, a simple low-poly table. 

Instead of doing what I asked it, it wasted tons of tokens and quotas on frivolous useless shit like verifying MCP connection, deleting, testing models, and exhausting what would have been a week's worth of quota in half an hour. It sounds suspiciously like Sundar Pichai has hardcoded this into the agent to get me to sign up for the paid plan. If that's the endgame, I'm sorry it doesn't work on brokies like me.

How do you actually get an AI agent to do something useful in Blender instead of consuming tokens on mindless tasks.

No, I don't have the money for Claude Code or any paid plans in general, and I'm not making any Triple-A budget video games, I'm just a random hobbyist playing around with stuff. 

>!If this is what 3D artists fear will take their jobs, it sounds like they were dropped on their heads when they were young. It can't even create a simple model without wasting quotas on validating connection.!<

comments.author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
comments.body: Gemini is shit at the $20 plan let alone the free one haha. You need Ultra for Argon and then it one shots all 3D animations in blender. I bit the bullet but 100% worth it. Better than any model on the planet in blender.

replies.author: azicre
replies.body: That's great to hear! I will give it a shot myself. What are your returns like?

comments.author: JakSilver00
comments.body: So, I hate to be that guy, but you kind of need the paid tools to play this game. If you don't have the paid tools, you should probably be focusing on things to make money with the free tools, which is completely possible, I promise. Huge learning curve on all three points here. But if you just want the table, there are free assets you can use.

comments.author: SignificanceFun550
comments.body:
No chance. Even with the full MAX/ULTRA subs they still suck at modeling 3d objects.  
  
Buy paid assets from marketplaces and use them instead.  If it's a hobby; get your hands dirty.

comments.author: ElderZombie250
comments.body: The free tier of any of these tools is just basically for chatting.  You aren't going to get any serious work out any AI without a subscription.
